entries.title: Psalms 7:1
segments: ¶<<Shiggaion of David, which he sang to Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush the Benjaminite.>> Jehovah my God, in thee have I trusted: save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me;

entries.title: Psalms 7:2
segments: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, crushing it while there is no deliverer.

entries.title: Psalms 7:3
segments: Jehovah my God, if I have done this, if there be iniquity in my hands;

entries.title: Psalms 7:4
segments: If I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (indeed I have freed him that without cause oppressed me;)

entries.title: Psalms 7:5
segments: Let the enemy pursue after my soul, and take [it], and let him tread down my life to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 7:6
segments: Arise, Jehovah, in thine anger; lift thyself up against the raging of mine oppressors, and awake for me: thou hast commanded judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 7:7
segments: And the assembly of the peoples shall encompass thee; and for their sakes return thou on high.

entries.title: Psalms 7:8
segments: Jehovah shall minister judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity which is in me.

entries.title: Psalms 7:9
segments: Oh let the wrong of the wicked come to an end, and establish thou the righteous [man]; even thou that triest the hearts and reins, the righteous God.

entries.title: Psalms 7:10
segments: ¶My shield is with God, who saveth the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 7:11
segments: God is a righteous judge, and a *God who is indignant all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 7:12
segments: If one turn not, he will sharpen his sword; he hath bent his bow and made it ready,

entries.title: Psalms 7:13
segments: And he hath prepared for him instruments of death; his arrows hath he made burning.

entries.title: Psalms 7:14
segments: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood:

entries.title: Psalms 7:15
segments: He digged a pit, and hollowed it out, and is fallen into the hole that he made.

entries.title: Psalms 7:16
segments: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

entries.title: Psalms 7:17
segments: I will praise Jehovah according to his righteousness, and will sing forth the name of Jehovah the Most High.
